description: This file defines the AOS_Contracts class for SuiteCRM, extending custom contract functionality with methods for saving, deleting, and managing reminders and links to calls.

classes.name: AOS_Contracts
classes.description: Custom class for handling contract-related operations, including reminders, linking calls, and deletion logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the contract object and sets default renewal reminder date based on configuration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the contract, handling duplicate and related group data, and creates reminders and links as needed.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the contract and associated lines and calls as deleted.

methods.name: createReminder
methods.description: Creates a call reminder for contract renewal.

methods.name: createLink
methods.description: Creates a linked call for the renewal reminder.
